label: canonical Phase 1 genus-2 Jacobian lane
description: Preregistered direct higher-genus Phase 1 comparison on the pinned 18-bit prime subgroup of Jac(y^2 = 706 + 731x + 331x^2 + 360x^3 + 270x^4 + x^5) over F_769. Public targets, the strongest same-Jacobian rho comparator, a repeated A/A control, and the implemented hyperelliptic index-calculus candidate are fixed here. This executable spec is not a completed benchmark result.
